<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 550" width="500" height="550">
  <defs>
    <style>
      text { font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 16px; }
      .label { font-size: 15px; }
      .bold { font-weight: bold; }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="white" />

  <!-- Beaker -->
  <g id="beaker">
    <!-- Beaker walls -->
    <path d="M 150 250 L 150 450 Q 150 470 170 470 L 330 470 Q 350 470 350 450 L 350 250" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" />
    <!-- Beaker top rim ellipse indication (open top) -->
    <ellipse cx="250" cy="250" rx="100" ry="15" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <!-- Water inside beaker -->
    <path d="M 152 300 Q 250 315 348 300 L 348 450 Q 348 468 330 468 L 170 468 Q 152 468 152 450 Z" fill="#e6f2ff" stroke="none" />
    <!-- Water surface line -->
    <ellipse cx="250" cy="300" rx="98" ry="12" fill="#d0e8ff" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" />
  </g>

  <!-- Clamp / Stand (simplified representation holding capillary tube) -->
  <g id="stand">
    <rect x="235" y="60" width="30" height="40" fill="#fff" stroke="black" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="250" y1="100" x2="250" y2="130" stroke="black" stroke-width="4" />
    <!-- Bosshead / clamp -->
    <rect x="230" y="125" width="40" height="25" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="black" stroke-width="2" />
  </g>

  <!-- Capillary Tube and Visking Tubing Setup -->
  <g id="osmometer">
    <!-- Capillary tube (glass) -->
    <rect x="242" y="100" width="16" height="200" fill="#f9f9f9" stroke="black" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <!-- Liquid inside capillary tube (showing rise) -->
    <line x1="250" y1="140" x2="250" y2="295" stroke="#3399ff" stroke-width="6" />

    <!-- Rubber bung / stopper connecting tube to bag -->
    <path d="M 230 295 L 270 295 L 265 315 L 235 315 Z" fill="#cccccc" stroke="black" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Visking tubing bag -->
    <path d="M 235 315 Q 190 350 190 400 Q 190 440 250 445 Q 310 440 310 400 Q 310 350 265 315 Z" fill="#fff" stroke="black" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="none" />

    <!-- Sucrose solution inside bag -->
    <path d="M 236 316 Q 193 350 193 400 Q 193 438 250 443 Q 307 438 307 400 Q 307 350 264 316 Z" fill="#ffebcc" stroke="none" />
    <!-- Hatching inside bag to indicate concentrated solution -->
    <g stroke="#d9a36c" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6">
      <line x1="210" y1="350" x2="290" y2="350" />
      <line x1="200" y1="370" x2="300" y2="370" />
      <line x1="195" y1="390" x2="305" y2="390" />
      <line x1="200" y1="410" x2="300" y2="410" />
      <line x1="210" y1="430" x2="290" y2="430" />
    </g>
    <!-- Redraw bag outline for clarity -->
    <path d="M 235 315 Q 190 350 190 400 Q 190 440 250 445 Q 310 440 310 400 Q 310 350 265 315 Z" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="2" />
  </g>

  <!-- Labels and Leader Lines -->
  <g id="labels">
    <!-- Capillary tube label -->
    <line x1="258" y1="180" x2="370" y2="180" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="378" y="185" class="label">capillary tube</text>

    <!-- Liquid level label -->
    <line x1="253" y1="140" x2="370" y2="140" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="378" y="145" class="label">liquid level</text>

    <!-- Beaker / Distilled water label -->
    <line x1="150" y1="350" x2="80" y2="350" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="5" y="355" class="label">distilled water</text>

    <!-- Visking tubing bag label -->
    <line x1="190" y1="410" x2="80" y2="410" stroke="black" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="5" y="415" class="label">Visking tubing bag</text>
    <text x="5" y="432" class="label">containing</text>
    <text x="5" y="449" class="label">concentrated</text>
    <text x="5" y="466" class="label">sucrose solution</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Fig caption -->
  <text x="250" y="510" text-anchor="middle" class="bold">Fig. 2.1</text>
</svg>
